subject: GCP Marketplace listing — procurement & onboarding runbook
messages:
From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@gcp-partners.com>
Cc: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: GCP Marketplace listing — procurement & onboarding runbook

Hi Sarah,

Thanks again for connecting yesterday — really excited to get Nimbus Labs into the GCP Marketplace and aligned on the procurement path. I put together an initial runbook/checklist (attached) that lays out the steps we think need to happen on both sides so procurement can validate pricing and billing mechanics quickly. High level asks: 

- Confirm the billed SKU structure (subscription vs usage) and any mapping constraints from Nimbus' billing engine.
- Provide a primary procurement contact + legal POC for T&Cs review.
- Confirm required artifacts (SOC2 report, data processing addendum, indemnity language) and preferred delivery channels (DocuSign/Drive).
- Agree on target timeline for listing publish + co-sell enablement (we're aiming for a soft publish by mid-December).

Attachment: gcp_onboarding-checklist.xlsx (xlsx) — checklist, required docs, and owner column.

Can you confirm who from GCP will own the procurement intake and whether we should route docs to procurement@gcp-partners.com or directly to Marketplace review? If useful, happy to run a 30m alignment call next week.

Thanks,

--
Lauren Bishop
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@gcp-partners.com>

Subject: Re: GCP Marketplace listing — procurement & onboarding runbook

Hi Lauren — thanks for the tidy checklist, this is helpful. 

Short answers:
- Procurement intake: please send all formal procurement artifacts to procurement@nimbuslabs.com (I copied Matthew). For Marketplace review, we route the listing metadata & ISV docs into the Marketplace console. I'll own the internal routing to Marketplace review.
- Docs we typically need up front: SOC 2 Type II (or evidence claim + timeline), DPA, sample order form, and a completed Marketplace partner intake form. If you can share the SOC2 report or an auditor attestation, that speeds review.
- For billing, we support both subscription SKUs and metered SKUs; Jon, please confirm the SKU naming convention — we usually prefer vendor-provided SKU IDs to avoid mapping delays.

I can do an alignment call Thu 11/19 10am PT or Fri 11/20 9am PT — which works for you and Nimbus?

Thanks,
Sarah
Partner Programs Manager, GCP Marketplace
sarah.nguyen@gcp-partners.com

Thanks for the notes, Sarah & Lauren. A few technical/policy items from the RDC (runtime/ops) side to call out so procurement understands what will be on the billing & listing side: 

- SKU model: Redwood recommends a single subscription SKU for "Redwood Inference - Nimbus Labs (bundle)" plus an optional metered SKU for overage/usage. This reduces friction for resellers and co-sell programs. If Nimbus insists on separate product SKUs per feature, we will need a SKU map file (CSV) that the Marketplace team can ingest.
- Billing flow: Marketplace charges Google-invoiced customers and remits to the vendor net of GCP fees; Nimbus needs to confirm if they want Google to bill customers or prefer direct billing via vendor-managed billing. The latter requires additional merchant onboarding.
- Compliance artifacts: SOC2 (pdf), DPA (signed), and the vendor questionnaire answered in the partner console is sufficient to start review. Pricing redlines (if any) should be shared as a clean PDF.
- Timeline risk: Listing metadata freeze should be at least 5 business days before requested publish. If we aim for Dec 15 publish, we need final artifacts no later than Dec 6.

Helpful links:
- Marketplace listing upload: https://console.cloud.google.com/marketplace/listing/new
- Partner submission guide (internal): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-gcp-runbook

I'll join the alignment call. Marissa, can you confirm legal has a replacement clause ready for Nimbus' order form; if not, we'll need to route to legal for a 48-hour review.

--
Jonas Weber
Principal Product Manager, Runtime
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai

2) Jonas: prepare the SKU recommendation doc (short CSV + mapping notes) and confirm whether we can collapse to a single subscription SKU with a metered overage.
3) I'll consolidate artifacts and send to procurement@nimbuslabs.com and Sarah by EOD Friday so they can start their internal intake.

Thanks all — keeping this tight will help us hit a December listing target.
